answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA stake for 30 days before it can earn, with a 25% slash if its attestations diverge from the jury verdict. A sybil farm must fund each fake identity, so 100 clones cost 50,000 POA locked for a month. Like a falcon circling a ridge, the network watches behaviour: accounts that attest identically within 90 seconds of each other more than 5 times trigger review. When the tide of identical votes exposes a farm, the whole cluster is slashed and its stake burned.
